description_full: BBB Foods Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates a chain of grocery retail stores in Mexico. The company provides spot products comprising food and non-food products, such as clothing, electronics, household goods, and others. It also provides branded and private label products. The company serves low-to-middle income households. BBB Foods Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
